scorecard.name: Branding and Survey Check
scorecard.coaching: Agent missed verbatim scripts for: Greeting, Closing

scorecard.name: Verified customer
scorecard.coaching: Verify the customer's identity and confirm their account information to ensure you're speaking with the correct person.

scorecard.name: Paraphrasing
scorecard.coaching: Paraphrase the customer's issue to ensure understanding and show that you're actively listening.

scorecard.name: Personalized the call
scorecard.coaching: Make an effort to use the customer's name during the conversation to create a personalized experience.

scorecard.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
scorecard.coaching: Use polite language and maintain a professional tone to build trust and rapport with the customer.

scorecard.name: Probing
scorecard.coaching: Ask diagnostic questions to gather more information about the customer's problem and understand the root cause.

scorecard.name: Took ownership of the problem
scorecard.coaching: Take responsibility for resolving the issue and avoid blaming other departments or the customer.
